# Fixture Project

## Description

A small Markdown-notes project used as the repo state for a skill-creator eval.

## Repo map

- `sample/` - sample Markdown notes
- `skill/` - the skill being authored (created by the eval)

## Commands

- Build: `python -m compileall -q .`
- Test: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`
- Lint: `python -m ruff check .`
